capex.source: ESEF ifrs-full:PurchaseOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentClassifiedAsInvestingActivities; same reports (PP&E only; excludes intangibles)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: history growth was 7.5% FY24 and 3.2% FY25 (computed from filed revenue); fade from ~4.5% to 3.5% on maturing store/online growth, converging toward terminal.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 EBIT margin 20.06% (7997/39864), FY2024 19.55%, FY2023 18.94%; modest expansion held flat at 20.5%.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 filed net income 6,220 / pretax 8,020 implies ~22.4% effective rate (approx, ignores minorities); rounded to 22.5%.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 3.266% (ECB AAA 10Y, 2026-11-05) + beta 0.886 (Damodaran Europe Retail (General) cash-corrected unlevered beta; Inditex debt ~0 so no relevering) x Spain ERP 5.78% (Damodaran) = 8.4% cost of equity; debt weight ~0 so WACC = cost of equity.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro-area inflation/growth, below the 3.27% EUR risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: ESEF derived net_debt = total debt 2 (ifrs-full:CurrentBorrowings) - cash 5,276 (CashAndCashEquivalents); report 549300TTCXZOGZM2EY83-2026-01-31-ESEF-ES-0. No short-term investments tagged; lease liabilities excluded.

diluted_shares.source: not found: diluted weighted shares and diluted EPS are null in the ESEF data; not filled from memory. Reviewer must supply from the annual report (in millions).
